scope: Independent read-only production-source review after execution-memory cost-only simplification, planner dead-probe/duplicate turn-gate removal, follower counter cleanup, and conditional web FAILED recovery. No runtime/test source edits, action/service/web request or physical robot operation during this review. This is not a new full-system or real-robot pass.

reviewed_invariants.finding: Execution failure memory produces bounded directional costs and an empty hard-edge set for all planner adapter callers. Static/unknown/live/remembered occupancy and directed first-edge certificates remain independent hard constraints.

Accepted controller event IDs, not spatial-memory counts or old segments, own the three-event retry budget. A real registered physical episode may defer charging; unrelated side returns cannot create that exemption. No historical classifier, per-entry classification cache, entry_ids filter, legacy segment-block dispatch veto or timer-only hold_probe production call remains.

Physical recovery remains LOCAL then owned stop proof then verified reverse or unavailable verdict then GLOBAL then FOLLOW/WAIT. Same-goal/map/episode correlation and no timer-only WAIT reopening are retained.

Follower retains source/receipt freshness, raw scan validity, local-costmap/footprint frame/time/model consistency and current goal ownership before dispatch. Material heading alignment requires the previous action to end and dense independent source-stamped odometry to prove stillness; initial and changed-route Spin start budgets remain bounded.

Verified reverse retains real odometry trail/current projection, complete raw occupied/unknown/body sweep, full-inflation exit and same-goal oracle. Follower requires old action ownership to clear, fresh rear sensing and exact source-pose certificate before Nav2 collision-checked BackUp; action acceptance is not actual reverse success.

Web historical FAILED becomes a warning only with fresh current configured-map/positive TF/health/autonomous/current readiness proof. WAITING or pending prior requests still block. It does not mutate failed/verified certificates, localization_invalidated, ESTOP or mission commands.

Final command publication retains exclusive command ownership, source lease/health/ESTOP priority, zero-output reset window, gentle acceleration and a second raw body/trajectory guard on the actual ramped command. Stops/collision holds remain immediate zero.
